scientific_limitations: Applies to finite simple graphs and their 2-step graphical Lie algebras, not arbitrary nilpotent Lie algebras.
Counts maximum-dimensional abelian ideals, not all inclusion-maximal ideals or their automorphism orbits.
The coordinate-subspace scheme classification is stratumwise; global components and scheme singularities are not determined.
Finite computations corroborate the proof but do not provide independent verification or exhaustive publication-priority verification.
title: Schubert–Stanley–Reisner census of maximal abelian ideals in graphical Lie algebras
